run_plot_pareto: run the plot_pareto function to generate a Pareto frontier plot from vLLM parameter sweep results
build_sweep_plot_pareto_cli: build a CLI command using SweepPlotParetoArgs to plot Pareto frontier from sweep results with configurable GPU and user count vars
test_pareto_frontier: test the _pareto_frontier function to extract non-dominated points from a DataFrame sorted by two metrics
review_sweep_plot_pareto_args: review the SweepPlotParetoArgs dataclass and its CLI argument parsing for the plot_pareto tool
summarize_prepare_records: summarize the _prepare_records function that transforms raw sweep data into tokens_per_user and tokens_per_gpu metrics
